column1: # 180 hand-written example messages, 30 per class, 6 classes.
# Written from Gottman's descriptions (Four Horsemen + bids + affection) and from
# the public chat patterns in the love deep-research notes.
# These are SEED / synthetic examples, not real private chats. Real-world accuracy
# will be lower than the held-out seed accuracy — see README.md.
